code_map.title: Code Map

put.description: Owner assigns a workspace developer to one application; the developer may then change only that application.

post.description: Issue a source credential bound to one application and environment. The token is shown exactly once.
Assemble one proposed profile revision from this application's accepted phase A and C proposals; another person activates it.
Template-based starter profile from declared facts; it still needs an independent review.
The token is shown exactly once; the relay stores it in the customer's own secret store.
Store an authorized source snapshot privately and queue analysis; source is never executed.

get.description: Progress feed. Clients reconnect by reloading this authoritative state.

post.description: Demo only: ordinary (non-test) customer traffic so runtime monitoring has something to observe.
Synthetic labs only: switch the lab's release through its declared release switch, then submit it as a new release.
Owner-requested erasure. The run stays as metadata; its controls become unavailable and need fresh evidence.

get.description: Authorized download of the exact stored bytes; integrity is verified before sending.

post.description: Signature-verified, deduplicated. Records the exact SHA for a bound repository; gate checks run per commit.
Called by the customer's pipeline with a CI credential bound to one application.
Deployment-time check: the receipt must still be valid for this exact commit right now.
Signed-in customer identity (it may not belong to any workspace yet) accepts an invitation addressed to it.

put.description: Owner grants a role, or revokes access with role null. Revocation takes effect on the member's next request.

get.description:
Scoped evidence bundle: the frozen published report, its accepted explanations and the exact evidence it cites.

Every file is listed with its SHA-256 in manifest.json. Evidence whose stored bytes fail their
integrity check is listed as unavailable instead of being exported. Internal staff notes, drafts
and other applications are never included.

post.description: Per-event acceptance; accepted events are persisted before this returns.

get.description: Active case load per staff member: counts, states and queue ages from the case index only.

post.description: An analyst may claim an untriaged case that has no analyst yet.
Propose, accept or reject a dependency edge; a proposer cannot accept their own proposal.

get.description: Raw evidence through the case-scoped grant only.

post.description: Confirm a disputed finding or record an audited determination that it was erroneous.
Move one duty from one person to another in a single transaction; separation of duties still holds.
Independent review: the drafter cannot publish, and the snapshot must still describe the current release.
Creates the workspace and invites the contact as its owner; no staff access to tenant data is granted by this.

get.description: Platform health only: counts and ages, never customer content.

put.description: Owner decision. External processing applies only to phases approved for an external provider.
